messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] How to reload INLA results
parts:
On Tue, 2017-04-04 at 11:37 -0700, Ruby Ji wrote:
> Dear all,
>
> I run an INLA model and used "keep=TRUE" to keep all the ini file and
> all input files. Then I closed the R. Now I want to make projections
> using "inla.mesh.project". Is it possible to reload the INLA results?
> Otherwise I need to rerun the model.
>
> Thanks,
> Ruby
>

sure, use 'inla.collect.results()'


> r = inla(y~1, data = data.frame(y=0), keep=TRUE)
Model and results are stored in working directory [inla.model-1]
> r = inla.collect.results("inla.model-1")
